steps.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: shared backing and frame for game map point icons. A single empty perfectly circular dark fantasy game map medallion base, straight-on view. Circular outer edge fits inside 90 percent of a square canvas, perfectly centered. Continuous thick aged pale silver pewter rim with a very subtle warm bronze inner lip, only four small embedded rivets at cardinal directions, all INSIDE the circle: no spikes, no crest. Bright continuous outer bevel visibly separates the dark nearly black outline from a map. Inside disk is solid opaque near-black charcoal #111513 with faint matte hammered iron texture, extremely calm and evenly dark, no emblem. Evenly round geometry. Top-front-left key light. Transparent outside the circle. No symbol, text, hole, cutout inside, letters, numerals, jewels or ornate decorations. Designed to remain readable as 48px UI. Render at 1024x1024.
